import sys
from math import comb

def solve():
    MOD = 998244353
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+N]]
    
    # prefix sums
    P = [0]*(N+1)
    for i in range(N):
        P[i+1] = (P[i] + A[i]) % MOD
    
    # powers[k][i] = P[i]^k mod MOD
    powers = [[1]*(N+1) for _ in range(K+1)]
    for k in range(1, K+1):
        prev = powers[k-1]
        cur = powers[k]
        for i in range(N+1):
            cur[i] = prev[i] * P[i] % MOD
    
    # f[a] = sum_{0<=j<i<=N} P[i]^a * P[j]^(K-a)
    f = [0]*(K+1)
    # pref[b] = sum_{j seen so far} P[j]^b
    pref = [0]*(K+1)
    # include j=0: P[0]=0, so P[0]^0 = 1, P[0]^b = 0 for b>0
    pref[0] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, N+1):
        for a in range(K+1):
            b = K - a
            f[a] = (f[a] + powers[a][i] * pref[b]) % MOD
        # add P[i] to prefix sums for future j
        for b in range(K+1):
            pref[b] = (pref[b] + powers[b][i]) % MOD
    
    ans = 0
    for k in range(K+1):
        sign = 1 if (K-k) % 2 == 0 else -1
        ans = (ans + sign * comb(K, k) * f[k]) % MOD
    
    print(ans % MOD)
